parts.text: 否定疑问句构成 否定疑问句的意思是 疑问+否定 构成的，即：一般疑问句的疑问词+not 的缩略式 何时用？(翻译：“难道，难道不…”) 组织步骤 ① 变：一般疑问句+ not 缩略式 ② 直接说（先看词性，再看人称）
Are you ok? → Aren’t you ok?
Do you know that? → Don’t you know that?
Can you wait ? → Can ’t you wait ?
A. Aren’t you lucky ！ 表达强调
B. Don’t you love me? 表达情绪
Is she beautiful? ⇒ Isn’t she beautiful? 难道她不漂亮吗？
Does she have a boyfriend? ⇒ Doesn’t she have a boyfriend? 难道她没有男朋友吗？
Did you have a date yesterday? ⇒ Didn’t you have a date yesterday?难道你昨天没去约会？
Can you be tender? ⇒ Can’t you be tender? 难道你就不能温柔一点吗？
Don’t you understand ? 难道你不懂吗？(一般现在时)
Didn’t she cook ? 难道她没做饭？(一般过去时)
Isn’t he cool? 难道他不帅？(一般现在时)
Wasn’t he late? 难道他没迟到？(一般过去时)
Didn’t you sleep ? 难道你没睡着 ？(一般过去时)
Aren’t you lucky ! 你们真幸运啊！(一般现在时)

sentences.title: 一般现在时变为一般过去时

rows: She buys a new car every year.
She bought a new car last year.
She airs the room every day.
He lost his pen this morning.
She always listens to the news.
She listened to the news yesterday.
She empties this basket every day.
